sources.app.contract:
// Acme Market: two tabs, each its own stack: a list that pushes a detail in each.
// The root tablist is the iOS tab bar; a screen a tab pushed survives a visit to the other.
// Each tab's list has the bar's search field, its own query (`contract vocab search`).
// App-drawn bars have a different layout: run `bun exact.mjs contract vocab tabs`.
// A native badge uses its box's inner text; XCUITest finds the tab by `tab-saved`.
use EmptyState from "exact:content"

routes nav
  tab places "/"
    place "/place/:id"
    cart "/cart"
      checkout "/checkout"
        done "/done"
  tab saved "/saved"
    savedPlace "/saved/:id"

shape Engine
  name: string

shape Place
  id: string
  name: string
  area: string
  about: string
  price: number

fn nameOf(places: Place[], id: string): string = match first(places.filter(p => p.id == id)) { case some(p) => p.name, case none => "" }
fn money(n: number): string = `$${n}`
fn priceOf(places: Place[], id: string): number = match first(places.filter(p => p.id == id)) { case some(p) => p.price, case none => 0 }
fn matches(p: Place, q: string): bool = p.name.toLowerCase().includes(q.trim().toLowerCase()) or p.area.toLowerCase().includes(q.trim().toLowerCase())

component App
  state saved = [] persist
  state placesQuery = ""
  state savedQuery = ""
  state cart = []
  state buyer = ""
  state ordered = ""
  resource places = loadPlaces() as shape Place[] else empty()
  // Which engine runs the data module: "hermes" on the native hosts, "browser" on the web. The cart
  // reads it, so the native cart's layout differs from the web's on purpose (exact phase 3's planted difference).
  resource engine = whichEngine() as shape Engine else empty()
  derive cartItems = places.filter(p => cart.includes(p.id))
  derive cartTotal = sum(cartItems.map(p => p.price))
  derive placesShown = places.filter(p => matches(p, placesQuery))
  derive savedShown = places.filter(p => saved.includes(p.id) and matches(p, savedQuery))
  action pick(name: string)
    nav = select(nav, name)
  // A row is a link to its place; the browser's Back, Forward and a deep link arrive here too.
  action follow(url: string)
    nav = go(nav, url)
  action search(tab: string, v: string)
    if tab == "saved"
      savedQuery = v
    else
      placesQuery = v
  // The empty Saved tab's button opens the first place on top of it.
  action browse
    nav = push(nav, path("savedPlace", "1"))
  action add(id: string)
    cart = cart.includes(id) ? cart : cart.concat([id])
  action openCart
    nav = push(nav, path("cart"))
  action checkout
    nav = push(nav, path("checkout"))
  action name(v: string)
    buyer = v
  action placeOrder
    ordered = buyer == "" ? "Guest" : buyer
    cart = []
    nav = replace(nav, path("done"))
  action toggle(id: string)
    saved = saved.includes(id) ? saved.filter(s => s != id) : saved.concat([id])
  view
    main navigationKey=`${top(nav).id}` navigationBack="back" navigate=follow testId="app" width="100%" height="100%"
      display="flex" flex-direction="column"
      column flex=1 min-height=0 position="relative"
        for t in nav.tabs key=t.name
          column role="tabpanel" id=`panel-${t.name}` position="absolute" inset=0
            for e in t.stack key=e.id
              column navigationKey=`${e.id}` navigationScroll=`content-${e.id}` position="absolute" inset=0
                display="flex" flex-direction="column"
                header display="flex" flex-wrap="wrap" align-items="center" gap=8 padding="8px 16px"
                  text (e.name == "places" ? "Acme Market" : e.name == "saved" ? "Saved" : e.name == "cart" ? "Cart"
                    : e.name == "checkout" ? "Checkout" : e.name == "done" ? "Order placed" : nameOf(places, e.params.id))
                    role="heading" aria-level=(e.name == "places" or e.name == "saved" ? 1 : 2) flex=1 color="brand.ink"
                  if e.name == "place" or e.name == "savedPlace"
                    button press=toggle(e.params.id) aria-label=(saved.includes(e.params.id) ? "Remove from Saved" : "Save")
                      testId=`save-${t.name}`
                      image (saved.includes(e.params.id) ? "symbol:bookmark-fill" : "symbol:bookmark")
                  if e.name == "places" or e.name == "place"
                    button press=openCart testId="open-cart" aria-label=`Cart, ${cart.length} ${cart.length == 1 ? "item" : "items"}`
                      image "symbol:cart"
                      text `${cart.length}` font-variant-numeric="tabular-nums"
                  if e.name == "places" or (e.name == "saved" and saved.length > 0)
                    input type="search" value=(t.name == "saved" ? savedQuery : placesQuery) input=search(t.name)
                      placeholder="Search" aria-label=(t.name == "saved" ? "Search Saved" : "Search Places")
                      testId=`search-${t.name}` width="100%"
                if e.name == "places" or e.name == "place"
                  ShippingNote()
                if e.name == "place" or e.name == "savedPlace"
                  PriceTag(amount=money(priceOf(places, e.params.id)))
                if e.name == "place"
                  row padding="4px 16px"
                    button press=add(e.params.id) testId="add-to-cart" buttonStyle="filled"
                      text (cart.includes(e.params.id) ? "In your cart" : "Add to cart")
                // An empty tab and a search with no match are each an `EmptyState` in the list's place.
                if e.name == "cart"
                  CartView(items=cartItems, total=money(cartTotal), engine=engine.name, go=checkout)
                else if e.name == "checkout"
                  column padding="12px 16px" gap=12
                    text `${cartItems.length} ${cartItems.length == 1 ? "item" : "items"}, ${money(cartTotal)}` testId="checkout-summary"
                    input value=buyer input=name placeholder="Your name" aria-label="Your name" testId="buyer-name"
                    button press=placeOrder testId="place-order" buttonStyle="filled"
                      text "Place order"
                else if e.name == "done"
                  column padding="12px 16px" gap=8
                    text `Thank you, ${ordered}. Your order is on its way.` testId="confirmation"
                else if e.name == "saved" and saved.length == 0
                  EmptyState(symbol="symbol:bookmark", title="No Saved Places", message="Open a place and tap the bookmark.")
                    button press=browse testId="browse"
                      text "Browse"
                else if e.name == "places" or e.name == "saved"
                  if (t.name == "saved" ? savedShown : placesShown).length == 0 and not pending(places)
                    EmptyState(symbol="symbol:search", title="No Results", message="Check the spelling or try a new search.")
                  else
                    list id=`content-${e.id}` appearance="auto" listStyle="inset-grouped" flex=1 min-height=0
                      section
                        for p in (t.name == "saved" ? savedShown : placesShown) key=p.id
                          link href=(e.name == "saved" ? path("savedPlace", p.id) : path("place", p.id)) testId=`${t.name}-${p.id}`
                            column flex=1 min-width=0 gap=2 padding-top=4 padding-bottom=4
                              text p.name
                              text p.area font="-exact-subheadline" color="-exact-secondary-label"
                            image "symbol:forward-chevron"
                else
                  list id=`content-${e.id}` appearance="auto" listStyle="inset-grouped" flex=1 min-height=0
                    for p in places.filter(x => x.id == e.params.id) key=p.id
                      section
                        row
                          text "Area"
                          text p.area
                      section
                        row padding-top=10 padding-bottom=10
                          text p.about flex=1 min-width=0 testId=`about-${t.name}`
      row role="tablist" testId="tabs"
        button role="tab" aria-controls="panel-places" aria-selected=(nav.tab == "places") press=pick("places")
          testId="tab-places" flex=1
          image "symbol:home"
          text "Places"
        button role="tab" aria-controls="panel-saved" aria-selected=(nav.tab == "saved") press=pick("saved")
          testId="tab-saved" flex=1
          image "symbol:bookmark"
          text "Saved"
          if saved.length > 0
            row background-color="-exact-system-red" border-radius=12
              text `${saved.length}` font-variant-numeric="tabular-nums"

// One line of shop copy, shown on the places list and a place's page only.
component ShippingNote
  view
    text "Free shipping on orders over $75" font="-exact-footnote" color="note.ink"
      padding="4px 16px" testId="shipping-note"

// A place page's price line; its look is the shared Price style, not its own attributes.
component PriceTag
  props
    amount: string
  view
    text `From ${amount}` class=Price testId="price"

// The cart: its rows, the total and the way to checkout. On the native hosts the total sits above the rows,
// on the web below them — planted on purpose (exact phase 3), for the canvas's compare to find and name.
component CartView
  props
    items: Place[]
    total: string
    engine: string
    go: action
  view
    if items.length == 0
      EmptyState(symbol="symbol:cart", title="Your Cart Is Empty", message="Open a place and tap Add to cart.")
    else
      list appearance="auto" listStyle="inset-grouped" flex=1 min-height=0 testId="cart-list"
        if engine == "hermes"
          section
            row testId="cart-total"
              text "Total" flex=1
              text total font-variant-numeric="tabular-nums"
        section
          for p in items key=p.id
            row testId=`cart-${p.id}`
              text p.name flex=1
              text money(p.price) font-variant-numeric="tabular-nums"
        if engine != "hermes"
          section
            row testId="cart-total"
              text "Total" flex=1
              text total font-variant-numeric="tabular-nums"
        section
          button press=go testId="checkout"
            text "Checkout"

style Price
  font="-exact-title3" color="brand.ink" padding="12px 16px 4px"
